retainedReference.title: Great Equatorial Building, Royal Observatory Greenwich

pictures.author: Robert von Oliva (naruciakk)
pictures.observed: Actually viewed960px portrait: complete octagonal stock-brick base, three levels of sash lights, pale string bands, projecting white gallery with brackets, green onion dome bulging beyond the base and narrowing to fenced crown; neighboring rectangular range remains separate.

pictures.author: Elliott Brown
pictures.observed: Actually viewed1280px courtyard-side picture: prominent onion profile and narrow curved seams, dark crown railing, eight-sided stock-brick facades with red flat sash arches, pale bands, white timber-looking gallery and dark support brackets. No copied lettering or pasted pixels.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Independent Great Equatorial Building: octagonal stock-brick three-storey base, pale string/cornice bands, sash lights/red flat arches, bracketed white projecting gallery, broad pale-green onion dome with curved seams/closed shutter cue and small fenced crown. Keep the Meridian range, all earlier Observatory assets and every separate building as context. No telescope optics, furnished rooms, operating dome or copied signs.
